title: The Ball in the Well
lines: Bill runs up a tall hill.
Bill tips the ball off the hill.
Mom gets the ball for Bill.

questions.listenFor: In a well. It is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with the word well in it.

questions.ask: Who gets the ball back for Bill?
questions.listenFor: His dad. Follow up with "and how did Mom know to come?" to see if they linked the yell to the help.

questions.ask: Do you think Bill should roll the ball down the hill again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. Listen for a reason tied to what happened, like "no, it fell in the well."
